cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
死亡军团医疗兵
2 6" 5+ 7
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
激光枪 4 4+ 2/3 -
刺刀 3 4+ 2/3 -
医疗兵!：在每个转折点中，首次有另一名位于该特工 3" 内且可见的己方死亡军团特工将被残废时，如
果该特工或者那名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用此规则。若使用，那么那名己方特
工不会被残废，并且剩余 1 点耐伤并且直到行动结束前不能被残废。在那次行动结束后，那名己方特工可
以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是必须在该特工的控制范围内结束这次移动。直到该特工和那名特
工的下一次激活结束前，他们的 APL 属性各减少 1 点。如果您在那名特工的激活期间使用了本规则，那
么那次激活结束。您不能在该特工残废时，或者在该特工被选择成为一次射击行动的主要或次要目标时使
用此规则。
请继续阅读背面规则
死亡军团、帝国、星界军、医疗、医疗兵 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
DEATH KORPS MEDIC
2 6" 5+ 7
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Lasgun 4 4+ 2/3 -
Bayonet 3 4+ 2/3 -
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly DEATH KORPS operative would be incapacitated while
visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of an
enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the
remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that
move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations
respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use this rule if this
operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
DEATH KORPS , IMPERIUM, ASTRA MILITARUM, MEDIC 25

布雷兵：该特工携带有己方地雷标识。该特工可以
对这枚标识执行拾取标识行动，并且在对这枚标识
执行放置标识行动时，可以在之后立刻执行一次无
消耗的冲刺行动。
*引爆：不要选择一个有效目标。作为替代，对己方地雷标识
2" 内的每一名特工进行射击，除非特工与标识之间存在一个
造成阻碍的重型地形。每一名被射击的特工不能拥有掩护或
被遮挡。按照您选择的顺序为每一次流程进行掷骰。如果己
方地雷标识不位于杀戮区，则您不能选择该武器。在行动结
束时，将己方地雷标识移出杀戮区。在一个使用近距离战斗
规则的杀戮区中（如杀戮区：墓穴世界），本武器拥有“致
命 5+”武器规则。
死亡军团、帝国、星界军、工程兵 25

Mine Layer: This operative is carrying your Mine marker. It can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that marker, and whenever it
performs the Place Marker action on that marker, it can immediately perform a free Dash action.
*Detonate: Don’t select a valid target. Instead, shoot against each operative within 2" of your Mine marker, unless Heavy terrain is
wholly intervening between that operative and that marker. Each of those operatives cannot be in cover or obscured. Roll each sequence

鼓舞启蒙：支援。位于该特工 3" 内的己方死亡军团
特工所装备的武器拥有“严重”武器规则。
死亡军团、帝国、星界军、狂热者 25

cards.text:
死亡军团
杀戮小队
原型：安全保护、搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名死亡军团监军特工，装备有以下选项：
• 爆矢枪；刺刀
或者从以下选项中各选择一件武器进行装备：
• 爆矢手枪；等离子手枪；圣物激光枪
• 链锯剑；动力武器
↘ 4 名士兵特工
↘ 9 名死亡军团特工，从以下列表中选择：
• 格斗兵
• 亲信，装备有以下一种选项：
○ 爆矢枪或激光枪；刺刀
○ 爆矢手枪或圣物激光手枪；链锯剑
• 炮手，装备有火焰喷射器和刺刀
• 炮手，装备有榴弹发射器和刺刀
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: SECURITY, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 DEATH KORPS WATCHMASTER operative
with the following:
• Boltgun; bayonet
Or one option from each of the following:
• Bolt pistol, plasma pistol or relic laspistol
• Chainsword or power weapon
↘ 4 TROOPER operatives
↘ 9 DEATH KORPS operatives selected from the
following list:
• BRUISER
• CONFIDANT with one of the
following options:
○ Boltgun or lasgun; bayonet
○ Bolt pistol or relic laspistol; chainsword
• GUNNER with bayonet and flamer
• GUNNER with bayonet
and grenade launcher
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

• 炮手，装备有热熔枪和刺刀
• 炮手，装备有等离子枪和刺刀
• 医疗兵
• 工程兵
• 狙击手
• 观察手
• 士兵
• 老兵
• 通讯兵
• 狂热者
除了士兵特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被纳
入您的杀戮小队一次。
最多四次，您可以选择不将本选项中的一名士
兵特工纳入杀戮小队，作为替代，您可以在战
斗中选择一个死亡军团计谋，选择的计谋在
战斗中消耗 0CP。
cards.text_en:
• GUNNER with bayonet and meltagun
• GUNNER with bayonet and plasma gun
• MEDIC
• SAPPER
• SNIPER
• SPOTTER
• TROOPER
• VETERAN
• VOX-OPERATOR
• ZEALOT
Other than TROOPER operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.
Up to four times, instead of selecting one of
these TROOPER operatives, you can select
one DEATH KORPS ploy to cost you 0CP for
the battle.

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营规则
守卫命令
克里格死亡军团的士兵们对自己的军官拥有
绝不动摇的衷心，他们执行命令的速度和效
率受到了诸多其他兵团的嫉妒。
战略计划和支援。一名己方死亡军团监军特工
可以发布一条守卫命令。在选择发布时，选择一
个守卫命令效果，该特工 6" 内的所有己方死亡
军团特工都将接收到那条命令。
每当一名己方特工接收到守卫命令时，命令的规
则效果将持续至转折点结束为止。特工不能在同
时受到多条守卫命令效果的影响；他们只能获得
在转折点中最后接收到的命令效果。
守卫命令选项将在单独的卡片上分别进行表示
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION RULE
GUARDSMEN ORDERS
The soldiers of the Death Korps of Krieg are
unquestioningly loyal to their officers, following barked
orders with a speed and efficiency that is the envy of
many other regiments.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT and SUPPORT. A friendly
DEATH KORPS WATCHMASTER operative
can issue a GUARDSMAN ORDER. Whenever it
does, select one GUARDSMAN ORDER for all
friendly DEATH KORPS operatives within 6" of it
to receive.
Whenever a friendly operative receives a
GUARDSMAN ORDER, apply its rules until the end
of the turning point. Operatives cannot benefit
from more than one GUARDSMAN ORDER at
once; they only benefit from the most recent
order they received during the turning point.
GUARDSMEN ORDERS OPTIONS ARE
PRESENTED ON THEIR OWN CARDS

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营规则
守卫命令
瞄准！
克里格的士兵们为步兵消耗战
进行了专门的训练，每一名战
士都经历了长时间的激光枪射
击训练。
接收到本命令的特工的远程武器（迫击炮轰炸和
远程引爆器除外）拥有“无休”武器规则。
上刺刀！
克里格死亡军团所参与的战斗需
要士兵们熟知近距离战斗和战壕
扫荡的技巧。
接收到本命令的特工的近战武器拥
有“无休”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION RULE
GUARDSMEN ORDERS
Take Aim!
Outfitted and trained for attritional
infantry combat, the soldiers of Krieg
have undertaken endless hours of
lasgun drills.
Ranged weapons of operatives that received
this order (excluding mortar barrage and remote
detonator) have the Ceaseless weapon rule.
Fix Bayonets!
The kind of warfare undertaken by
the Death Korps of Krieg requires
their troopers to be well versed
in close-quarters fighting and
trench clearance.
Melee weapons of operatives that received this
order have the Ceaseless weapon rule.

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营规则
守卫命令
坚守阵地！
克里格的士兵们极其固执，他们
在建立了防守阵地后会以坚强的
决心奋战到底。
每当一名特工对接收到本命令的
己方特工进行射击时，如果您保留了任何掩护豁
免，那么您可以重掷任何一个指定结果的防御骰
（例如，所有结果为 2 的防御骰)。
冲！冲！冲！
在监军的命令下，克里格的士兵
们加快脚步，向下一个目标地
点冲去。
每当一名接收到本命令的己方特工执行转移行动
时，其移动属性提升 1"。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION RULE
GUARDSMEN ORDERS
Dig In!
Obstinate to the last, the soldiers of
Krieg establish defensive positions and
hold them with grim determination.
Whenever an operative is shooting
a friendly operative that’s received this order, if
you can retain any cover saves, you can re-roll
any of your defence dice results of one result (e.g.
results of 2).
Move! Move! Move!
Responding to a barked order from
their Watchmaster, the soldiers of Krieg
pick up the pace and hustle towards
their next objective.
Whenever an operative that’s received this order
is performing the Reposition action, add 1" to its
Move stat.

cards.text:
死亡军团
战略计谋
攻城战
死亡军团的步兵们在消耗巨大的攻城战中如鱼
得水，能够以相互重叠的火力网将敌人击退。
己方死亡军团特工的远程武器拥有“集中”
和“精准 1”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
STRATEGY PLOY
SIEGE WARFARE
Death Korps infantry are at home in the dreadful grind of
siege warfare, repelling their foes with overlapping fields
of withering fire.
Friendly DEATH KORPS operatives’ ranged
weapons have the Saturate and Accurate 1
weapon rules.

cards.text:
死亡军团
战略计谋
找掩护
克里格的士兵们习惯了在战壕与隧道的狭窄空
间中进行战斗，他们能够良好地运用周边环境
中任何可以利用的掩体。
每当一名特工对己方死亡军团特工进行射击
时，如果您可以保留任何掩护豁免，那么那名己
方特工的豁免属性提升 1。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
STRATEGY PLOY
TAKE COVER
Used to fighting in the close confines of trenches and
tunnels, Krieg soldiers make excellent use of whatever
meagre cover they can find.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
DEATH KORPS operative, if you can retain any
cover saves, improve that friendly operative’s
Save stat by 1.

cards.text:
死亡军团
战略计谋
清扫阵线
如果有敌人成功突破了防线，那么克里格的
士兵们也能够维持有序的纪律并击退入侵的
敌人。
己方死亡军团特工的近战武器拥有“精准 1”
武器规则。每当一名己方死亡军团特工在完全
位于己方领地内的情况下进行近战时，或者每当
那名特工进行反击时，其近战武器拥有“严重”
武器规则。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
STRATEGY PLOY
CLEAR THE LINE
Should the enemy break through, the soldiers of Krieg
are disciplined enough to retain their composure and
repel the foe.
Friendly DEATH KORPS operatives’ melee
weapons have the Accurate 1 weapon rule.
Whenever a friendly DEATH KORPS operative is
fighting wholly within your territory, or whenever
it’s retaliating, its melee weapons also have the
Severe weapon rule.

cards.text:
死亡军团
战略计谋
重整
就算是在混乱的战斗之中，克里格死亡军团的
士兵们依旧能够保持专注，在维持队形的同
时使用精准的激光射击消灭敌人。
支援。选择一名位于敌方特工 3" 外的己方死亡
军团特工。每一名位于被选择特工 5" 内且不
位于敌方特工控制范围内的其他己方死亡军团
特工可以立刻执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，
具体顺序由您来决定，但在这些特工结束移动
时，他们必须比原先要更接近被选择的特工。
请注意通用装备中的通讯装置只会影响本规则
的第二个距离。
您不能在同一转折点中同时使用本计谋以及“计
时器”阵营装备战略计划。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
STRATEGY PLOY
REGROUP
Even in the confusion of combat, the Death Korps of
Krieg retain their focus, returning to formation as they
destroy the enemy with accurate las fire.
SUPPORT. Select one friendly DEATH KORPS
operative that’s more than 3" from enemy
operatives. Each other friendly DEATH KORPS
operative within 5" of that operative and not
within control range of enemy operatives can
immediately perform a free Dash action in an
order of your choice, but each that does so must
end that move closer to that operative. Note that
a Comms Device from universal equipment only
affects the second distance of this rule.
You cannot use this ploy and the Chronometer
faction equipment STRATEGIC GAMBIT during
the same turning point.

cards.text:
死亡军团
交战计谋
领袖鼓舞
最伟大的军官会以身作则，在砍倒敌人的同时
传达精确的命令。
支援。在一名己方死亡军团监军或死亡军团
亲信特工的激活期间，在其执行一次行动之前
或之后使用本交战计谋。该特工发布一条守卫
命令。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FIREFIGHT PLOY
INSPIRATIONAL LEADERSHIP
The greatest officers lead by example, issuing orders
with calm precision even as they cut down their foes.
SUPPORT. Use this firefight ploy during a friendly
DEATH KORPS WATCHMASTER or DEATH
KORPS CONFIDANT operative’s activation,
before or after it performs an action. It issues a
GUARDSMAN ORDER.

cards.text:
死亡军团
交战计谋
联合作战
精准且协同的射击能够将强大的敌人击败。
在您为一名己方死亡军团特工掷攻击骰后，如
果该特工射击的敌方特工在转折点中也被另一
名己方死亡军团特工射击，那么您可以使用本
交战计谋。您可以重掷任何自己的攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FIREFIGHT PLOY
COMBINED ARMS
Precisely coordinated fire is capable of taking down
even the most potent of enemies.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly DEATH KORPS operative, if it’s
shooting an enemy operative that’s been shot by
another friendly DEATH KORPS operative during
this turning point. You can re-roll any of your
attack dice.

cards.text:
死亡军团
交战计谋
生即为耻辱
克里格教派要求每一位战士都为帝皇献身，因
此那些还未牺牲的士兵们会尝试在战场上达成
愈加伟大的壮举来赎罪。
在一名己方死亡军团特工被激活且获得交战命
令时使用本交战计谋。该特工接收每一条守卫命
令。本规则的优先度高于守卫命令规则的常规
限制。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FIREFIGHT PLOY
IN LIFE, SHAME
The Cult of Krieg demand sacrifice in the name of
the Emperor, so those who are yet to give their lives
must atone by achieving ever greater feats upon
the battlefield.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly DEATH
KORPS operative is activated and given an
Engage order. It receives every GUARDSMAN
ORDER. This takes precedence over the normal
rule that operatives cannot benefit from more
than one GUARDSMAN ORDER at once.

cards.text:
死亡军团
交战计谋
死即为偿罪
所有克里格的士兵们都注定将在战斗中死去。
牺牲教派教导他们必须通过死亡来为先祖的罪
行赎罪。
在一名就绪己方死亡军团特工被残废时，如果
它不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使
用本交战计谋。在将该特工移出杀戮区前，该特
工可以立刻执行一次无消耗的行动，并且您可以
为此更改它的命令。请注意，那名己方特工在那
次行动期间处于受创状态。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FIREFIGHT PLOY
IN DEATH, ATONEMENT
All soldiers of Krieg are destined to die in battle. The
Cult of Sacrifice teaches that in death they will earn
forgiveness for the sins of their forebears.
Use this firefight ploy when a ready friendly
DEATH KORPS operative is incapacitated, if it
isn’t within control range of enemy operatives.
Before it’s removed from the killzone, it can
immediately perform one free action and you
can change its order to do so. Note that friendly
operative is injured for the duration of that action.

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营装备
计时器
克里格死亡军团按照严格的时间计划执行着
战斗行动。将计时器同步能够保证每一名士
兵都可以遵守指挥部所定下的时限。
在第一或第二转折点中的战略计划，每场战斗限
一次。每一名完全位于己方领地内的己方死亡军
团特工可以立刻执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，
顺序由您来决定，但是在结束那次移动时，特
工必须比原先要更靠近对手的降落区或杀戮区
边缘。
您不能在同一转折点中使用本战略计划以及“重
整”战略计谋。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION EQUIPMENT
CHRONOMETER
Krieg combat operations are performed to strict
schedules. Synchronised chronometers ensure
operatives adhere to the time frames laid down
by command.
Once per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first
or second turning point. Each friendly DEATH
KORPS operative wholly within your territory
can immediately perform a free Dash action in an
order of your choice, but each that does so must
end that move closer to an opponent’s drop zone
or killzone edge.
You cannot use this STRATEGIC GAMBIT and
the Regroup strategy ploy during the same
turning point.

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营装备
通讯器
通讯传播器和接收器能够让分散的死亡军团
士兵们在混乱的战斗之中保持联络。
每当一名己方死亡军团监军或者己方死亡军团
亲信特工发布守卫命令时，您可以使用本规
则。若使用，那么您可以选择一名己方死亡军团
特工来接收那条命令，而不是发布者 6" 内的每
一名己方死亡军团特工。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMM-BEADS
Vox-casters and receivers allow Death Korps soldiers
to remain in contact even as they are separated in the
confusion of battle.
Whenever a friendly DEATH KORPS
WATCHMASTER or friendly DEATH KORPS
CONFIDANT operative issues a GUARDSMAN
ORDER, you can use this rule. If you do, instead
of each friendly DEATH KORPS operative within
6" of it receiving that order, you can select one
friendly DEATH KORPS operative to receive
that order.

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营装备
手斧
这些锋利的斧头并非武器，而是作为工具进
行配发的。但在无法使用刺刀的狭窄空间
中，它们也可以被作为近战武器使用。
己方死亡军团特工拥有以下近战武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
手斧 3 4+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION EQUIPMENT
HAND AXES
Issued primarily as tools rather than weapons, these
sharp-bladed axes can be utilised in melee should close
confines prevent the use of bayonets.
Friendly DEATH KORPS operatives have the
following melee weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Hand axe 3 4+ 3/4

cards.text:
死亡军团
阵营装备
化学轰炸
死亡军团呼叫了化学轰炸的火炮支援，这些
士兵们知道哪怕是密封的作战制服也无法抵
御这些毒气的侵袭。
战略计划，每场战斗限一次。将己方毒气标识放
置在杀戮区中；这个标识不能被放置在制高点地
形的下方。当一名特工位于标识的 3" 内时，其
APL 属性减少 1 点。在下一个战略阶段的就绪步
骤中，将标识移除。请注意，一名特工只有在位
于标识的 3" 内时才会获得 APL 的修正效果，如
果特工移动至了标识的 3" 外，那么其 APL 属性
不再受到本规则的影响。
cards.text_en:
DEATH KORPS
FACTION EQUIPMENT
GAS BOMBARDMENT
Calling for artillery support, the Death Korps request
a chemical barrage, knowing full well that even
enviro-sealed uniforms will not protect them from the
poisonous fumes.
Once per battle STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Place
your Gas marker in the killzone; it cannot be
placed underneath Vantage terrain. Whenever
an operative is within 3" of that marker, subtract
1 from its APL stat. In the Ready step of the next
Strategy phase, remove that marker. Note that
an operative’s APL stat is only changed while it’s
within 3" of that marker. If it moves more than
3" from that marker, its APL stat is no longer
changed by this rule.
